citations: SOP Para 9.1(i): suspension/seizure applies where an account is reported multiple times, on lawful LEA direction under S.106 BNSS
SOP Para 9.1(vi) and 5(vi): reported accounts are subject to Enhanced Due Diligence (S.12AA PMLA)
SOP Para 5(xiii) and Annexure-V: direct attribution where possible, pro-rata where commingled
SOP Para 5(ix): unwarranted freezing orders are discouraged
disclaimer: Decision support only. Deterministic rules, not a trained model and not validated on real bank data. The Investigating Officer decides.

factors.label: Fast pass-through (tainted money left within 30 min)
Clean balance is under 10% of account balance
No merchant document matched to every disputed UTR
Merchant documents match every disputed UTR

rationale: Medium score: suspend digital channels pending Enhanced Due Diligence, keep branch access.
